title: Appointing the day for the convening of the first session of the One Hundred Fourteenth Congress.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Requires the first regular session of the 114th Congress to begin at noon on Tuesday, January 6, 2015.

summary.headline: This law sets noon on January 6, 2015, as the day the 114th Congress starts its first session.
summary.what_it_does: Congress normally begins a new session on January 3 under the Constitution's default schedule, but this law moves the start date to Tuesday, January 6, 2015. It sets the time as noon. The measure is a joint resolution that became law after being signed.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The first session of the 114th Congress was set to begin at noon on January 6, 2015.
